integrity: Proof and finite arithmetic checks are supplied; exact computations do not replace infinite asymptotic proofs. No independent validation has been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two hub-connected stars with independent uniform-neighbor rate-one Poisson calls; initial infection at a hub; no recovery. The critical asymptotic claim uses a smaller leaf class of logarithmic size. An earlier general independent-edge representation is credited; global historical priority is not established.
title: A logarithmic source-and-last-vertex crossover for asynchronous rumor spreading on double stars
